query.query: SELECT p.mupolygonkey,p.mukey,m.musym,m.muname,p.mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS wkt FROM mupolygon p INNER JOIN mapunit m ON p.mukey=m.mukey WHERE p.mupolygonkey IN (SELECT mupolygonkey FROM SDA_Get_Mupolygonkey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POLYGON((-93.654 42.022,-93.646 42.022,-93.646 42.028,-93.654 42.028,-93.654 42.022))'))
